origine_fr: À gauche, 讠, la parole ; à droite, 亥, qui donnait le son mais se lit hài. Au départ, c'est un accord passé dans l'armée. Ce qui est convenu est dû : « devoir, il faut ».
origine_en: On the left, 讠, speech; on the right, 亥, which gave the sound but is read hài. At first it was an agreement made in the army. What is agreed is owed: “should, ought to”.

phrase.en: It's time for you to go to bed.
